header.desc: Help us make the building and infrastructure sector open source. We currently have two open positions.

job.title: Experienced System Administrator / DevOps (open source)

about.title: About us
about.desc: The OpenAEC Foundation is making the building and infrastructure sector open source. We develop, support and promote a complete ecosystem of open-source software for the entire AEC chain — already 17 production tools, 50+ repositories and thousands of downloads. Modelled on the Blender Foundation: everything open, everything free, forever. Behind those tools runs a growing, fully self-hosted infrastructure — and it needs an experienced administrator to take ownership of it.

do.title: What you will do
do.1: Set up and manage servers — Linux servers (Debian/Ubuntu) from bare metal to production, including reverse proxy, TLS, DNS and containerisation (Docker)
do.2: NextCloud — set up, scale and maintain it as a document platform (incl. OpenAEC Docs and IfcGit integration)
do.3: Stalwart Mail Server — manage our self-hosted email stack (IMAP/JMAP/SMTP) that powers the Y-app: deliverability, DKIM/SPF/DMARC, anti-spam
do.4: Safety & security — hardening, firewalls, fail2ban, secrets management, patching, GDPR, audit logging and a backup & disaster-recovery policy that actually works
do.5: Monitoring & uptime — proactive monitoring so problems surface before the customer notices them
do.6: Managed hosting — you support our paid hosting/SLA services for construction firms that want a managed environment

who.title: Who we are looking for
who.1: Experienced — you have demonstrably run Linux servers in production and know what breaks at 3 a.m.
who.2: Independent — you like working autonomously, take initiative and make the call yourself
who.3: Security mindset — you think in threat models, least privilege and backups-that-work by default
who.4: Open source in your blood — you feel at home in a Linux/CLI/Git world
who.docker: Container experience — you are comfortable with Docker (and ideally orchestration)
who.idealism: Idealism — you believe in open source and an open construction sector, and want to contribute to something bigger than yourself
who.5: Bonus: experience with Hetzner, Cloudflare, Proxmox, Ansible/Terraform, PostgreSQL/Redis, Prometheus/Grafana or self-hosted mail

offer.title: What we offer
offer.1: A key role in a mission-driven open-source foundation in the making
offer.2: Full freedom and ownership over the infrastructure — no locked-down processes
offer.3: Work with a modern, 100% open-source stack (Linux, Rust, Tauri, NextCloud, Stalwart)
offer.4: Hybrid working — workplace in Dordrecht, and working from home is perfectly fine

apply.title: Interested?
apply.desc: No cover letter. Your application is a vibe-coded app — a small app you built yourself (with the help of AI). Show us what you make. Send the link or code along with your CV or GitHub profile.

job2.title: Prompt Engineer with a building or structural engineering background

about.title: About this role
about.desc: Our tools calculate real construction: heat loss, structures, geotechnics and cost estimation. We build them with AI — but AI output is only as good as the domain knowledge steering and checking it. So we are looking for a prompt engineer who not only handles language models well, but truly masters the field: someone who knows the standard and instantly spots when a calculation is wrong.

do.title: What you will do
do.1: Write and optimise prompts for our AI-coding workflow — so models produce technically correct output
do.2: Translate standards into specs — turn building and structural standards (NEN 12831, NTA 8800, ISSO 51/53, Eurocode) into clear, verifiable specifications
do.3: Design verification — build verification calculations and test cases that check AI-generated calculations against the standard
do.4: Safeguard conformance in tools like Open Heatloss Studio, Open Calc Studio and Open Geotechniek Studio
do.5: Transfer domain knowledge to the development team and help shape product direction

who.title: Who we are looking for
who.1: At least 5 years' experience as a building engineer (bouwkundige) or structural engineer (constructeur)
who.2: Hard, deep expertise — you really know the standards. Not an 'I think so' level, but well-founded, verifiable knowledge
who.4: Analytical and precise — you check your own work, and an AI's, just as critically
who.5: Affinity with AI / language models — or the hunger to master prompt engineering quickly
who.idealism: Idealism — you believe in open source and an open construction sector, and want to contribute to something bigger than yourself
who.6: Bonus: some programming experience, Eurocode calculations, BIM/IFC or prior AI tooling

offer.title: What we offer
offer.1: A unique role at the intersection of construction and AI — you turn your expertise directly into software the whole sector uses
offer.2: Help build a mission-driven open-source foundation in the making
offer.3: Work with the latest AI models and a modern, 100% open-source stack
offer.4: Hybrid working — workplace in Dordrecht, and working from home is perfectly fine

apply.title: Interested?
apply.desc: No cover letter. Your application is a vibe-coded app — a small app you built yourself (with the help of AI), ideally something with a building or structural twist. Show us you can combine domain knowledge with AI. Send the link or code along with your experience.
